scope: One necklace; no metal clasp, rings or separate adjusters

tape.mass_basis: MIL-DTL5038K2016 TableIII; conditional on conforming, conditioned stock, not wet/contaminated assembly

thread.mass_basis: Retained engineering stitching allowance, not a manufacturer maximum or new lower mass claim

seams.stitch: 301 lockstitch, same selected thread in needle and bobbin
seams.instruction: Fold each wear-loop tape width once at the attachment passages and completed20mm overlap. Complete one rectangle and both diagonals at each of four overlaps. Centre the3mm-wide wear-loop stitching within the folded tape; use6mm-wide stitching on the unfolded main ends. Do not cut tape fibres, glue a seam or substitute a knot. Inspect balanced stitches, no skipped stitches, and intact edge margins. Seam strength and snag behaviour require physical qualification.
